item.title: [−2] Erratic monsoon, drought-like conditions hit India's agri-input makers in Q2
item.description:

item.title: [+1] Mumbai households feel grocery squeeze as onion, rice, pulses and cooking oil prices rise
item.description:
Signal: rising Indian food prices (India). 2 reports from https://www.tabla.com.sg/, The Times of India. Related: “Food Inflation Jumps in India Amid El Nino and Biofuel Pressures”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Better farm-gate prices

Why it matters: Food carries a large weight in India's CPI, so rising food prices squeeze household budgets and limit the RBI's room to cut rates.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −2, Bond market (G-Secs) −1
